function Tails(s: seq<bv8>,i: int,count: int,j: int): Check
    requires 0 <= i < |s| && 1 <= count <= 3 && i+count < |s| && 1 <= j <= count+1
    decreases count+1-j

lemma GoodByte(s: seq<bv8>,i: int,count: int,j: int,k: int)
    requires 0 <= i < |s| && 1 <= count <= 3 && i+count < |s| && 1 <= j <= k <= count
    requires Tails(s,i,count,j).Good?
    ensures Continuation(s[i+k])
    decreases count+1-j

lemma BadByte(s: seq<bv8>,i: int,count: int,j: int)
    requires 0 <= i < |s| && 1 <= count <= 3 && i+count < |s| && 1 <= j <= count+1
    ensures Tails(s,i,count,j).Bad? ==> i+j <= Tails(s,i,count,j).position <= i+count && !Continuation(s[Tails(s,i,count,j).position])
    decreases count+1-j

lemma TailsGood(s: seq<bv8>,i: int,count: int,j: int)
    requires 0 <= i < |s| && 1 <= count <= 3 && i+count < |s| && 1 <= j <= count+1
    ensures Tails(s,i,count,j).Good? <==> (forall p {:trigger Continuation(s[p])} | i+j <= p <= i+count :: Continuation(s[p]))

    decreases |s|-i

lemma ValidateUtf8(s: seq<bv8>,i: int)
    requires 0 <= i <= |s|
    ensures Validate(s,i).Good? <==> Utf8(s[i..])

function Width(s: seq<bv8>): int
    requires Utf8(s) && |s| > 0
    ensures 1 <= Width(s) <= |s|
    ensures Utf8(s[Width(s)..])
    ensures forall k {:trigger Continuation(s[k])} | 1 <= k < Width(s) :: Continuation(s[k])

function Scalar(s: seq<bv8>): int
    requires Utf8(s) && |s| > 0

lemma ScalarValid(s: seq<bv8>)
    requires Utf8(s) && |s| > 0
    ensures 0 <= Scalar(s) <= 1114111
    ensures Scalar(s) < 55296 || Scalar(s) > 57343
    ensures Width(s) == 1 ==> Scalar(s) < 128
    ensures Width(s) == 2 ==> 128 <= Scalar(s) <= 2047
    ensures Width(s) == 3 ==> 2048 <= Scalar(s) <= 65535
    ensures Width(s) == 4 ==> 65536 <= Scalar(s)

lemma UnitPrefix(s: seq<bv8>)
    requires Utf8(s) && |s| > 0
    ensures Utf8(s[..Width(s)])

lemma UnitAppend(head: seq<bv8>,tail: seq<bv8>)
    requires Utf8(head) && |head| > 0 && |head| == Width(head) && Utf8(tail)
    ensures Utf8(head+tail)

lemma SliceValid(s: seq<bv8>,a: int,b: int)
    requires Utf8(s) && 0 <= a <= b <= |s| && Boundary(s,a) && Boundary(s,b)
    ensures Utf8(s[a..b])
    decreases |s|

lemma MagnitudeCorrect(v: int)
    requires Int256(v)
    ensures MagnitudeImpl(v) == Abs(v)
    ensures 0 <= MagnitudeImpl(v) <= Half
    ensures (MagnitudeImpl(v) == 0) == (v == 0)

lemma SignedMagnitudeCorrect(v: int, negative: bool)
    requires Uint256(v)
    ensures v > (if negative then Half else Half - 1) ==> SignedMagnitudeImpl(v, negative) == Panic(17)
    ensures v <= (if negative then Half else Half - 1) ==> SignedMagnitudeImpl(v, negative) == Ok(if negative then -v else v)

lemma RemainderRule(n: int, d: int)
    requires d > 0
    ensures Remainder(n, d) == (if n < 0 then -(Abs(n) % d) else Abs(n) % d)
    ensures -d < Remainder(n, d) < d
    ensures n >= 0 ==> Remainder(n, d) >= 0
    ensures n <= 0 ==> Remainder(n, d) <= 0

lemma RestoreRemainder(n: int, magnitude: int, negative: bool, d: int)
    requires 0 <= magnitude
    requires n == (if negative then -magnitude else magnitude)
    requires 0 < d <= Half
    ensures SignedMagnitudeImpl(magnitude % d, negative) == Ok(Remainder(n, d))

    ensures AddImpl(a, b, m) == Specification(a + b, m)

    ensures MulImpl(a, b, m) == Specification(a * b, m)

lemma CompleteOutcomes(a: int, b: int, m: int)
    requires Int256(a) && Int256(b) && Int256(m)
    ensures m == 0 ==> AddImpl(a, b, m) == Panic(18) && MulImpl(a, b, m) == Panic(18)
    ensures m != 0 ==> AddImpl(a, b, m).Ok? && MulImpl(a, b, m).Ok?
    ensures m != 0 ==> Int256(AddImpl(a, b, m).value) && Int256(MulImpl(a, b, m).value)
